pan: Use a smooth horizontal pan in the requested direction, keeping the same subject in focus.
push_in: Use forward physical camera motion as requested; do not replace it with a lens zoom.
pull_out: Use backward physical camera motion as requested; do not replace it with a lens zoom.
zoom: Change the lens framing as requested; do not replace it with physical camera movement.
dolly: Use the requested physical dolly movement; do not replace it with a lens zoom or subject motion.
tilt: Use the requested vertical camera tilt; do not replace it with subject motion.
orbit: Use the requested camera orbit around the subject; do not replace it with subject rotation.
tracking: Use the requested camera tracking movement; do not replace it with subject motion.
generic: Execute the named camera movement literally; do not replace it with a different camera movement or subject motion.
